Joule Studio, Agent Builder
Overview
  • Overview
  • Plans and pricing
  • Technical Information
  • Resources
/content/sapdx/countries/de_de/registration/request-demo.html

Easily build Joule agents to automate complex business processes.

Joule agents are designed to execute complex, adaptive workflows and drive end-to-end automation through Joule’s conversational or system interfaces. By leveraging advanced AI and orchestration capabilities, Joule Studio’s agent builder empowers business and IT users to create custom AI agents that plan, reason, and dynamically solve business problems—across SAP and non-SAP systems. Joule agents can autonomously coordinate multi-step processes, invoke APIs, interact with documents, and collaborate with users or other agents, enabling organizations to address challenges that exceed the scope of deterministic automation. With agent builder, you can tackle ambiguity, exceptions, and fragmented processes through powerful, context-aware logic and seamless tool integration. This allows businesses to unlock efficiency gains in scenarios that require expert decision-making, exception handling, or cross-system orchestration.

Overview

Reliable AI Agent Development

Build agents that achieve reliable outcomes by grounding them with your business data and processes

Seamless AI Agent Integration

Seamlessly connect to SAP and third-party applications and AI agents that augment the Joule Agents framework

Centralized AI Agent Management

Centrally manage skills and AI agents with visibility into agent execution and data privacy enforcement
